purpose: Machine-readable morning reconciliation receipt and fast-start manifest for MASTER_ROOT and all nine current peer owner roles under Topology 007, current program-job/completion locks and terminal Prose retirement.
program_job_rules: Every morning reconciliation reads CURRENT-AUTHORITY and its selected topology, program_job_lock and system_completion_status before interpreting completion or selecting work.
SYSTEM_MASTER and all nine active peers remain incomplete until explicit product-level completion authority changes their standing.
PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired with no active owner, execution, repair, qualification, research, telemetry, successor or claim domain.
BOOK owns any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability as ordinary Book work and retains canonical Book authority.
Each peer preserves its own semantic job and integrates upward through admitted interfaces.
PROGRAMMING is an admitted peer under Topology 007 and preserves the prior Programming work-program evidence as continuity input rather than restarting it.
WEBSITE_BUILDING is C40 under PROGRAMMING and uses the PROGRAMMING lane; browser/action side-effect authority remains CONNECTED_ACTIONS.
While SYSTEM-MASTER-KNOWLEDGE-RECOVERY-001 is selected, CORE administers Programming source/custody/provenance recovery as highest discretionary support without taking Programming product semantics.
master_root_rules: MASTER_ROOT is a chat role over SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance, not a peer system.
MASTER_ROOT reads all nine active peers, historical Prose evidence only when needed and shared infrastructure without silently taking product authority.
MASTER_ROOT has no peer-worker Second Shift lane; execution lanes are discovered from the Second Shift registry.
retired_prose_rules: PROSE does not receive a bootstrap packet, live owner lookup, repair route, qualification route, research task, telemetry ledger or successor task.
A user request about unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability resolves to BOOK and remains Book-owned.
Historical Prose artifacts/receipts remain exact-subject provenance only and cannot transfer PASS to changed Book integration bytes.
second_shift_rules: Discover active peer lanes from the selected topology execution-ready set; current Topology 007 contains nine lanes including PROGRAMMING.
Compare topology execution-ready peers to Second Shift owner_files and telemetry allowed_lanes on every reconciliation and require exact coverage.
Machine-resolvable missing coverage may be provisioned only for an already-declared execution-ready peer; missing coverage never creates a new system and retired systems are never provisioned.
Only one mutation-capable claim may be live per active peer lane.
Website Building uses PROGRAMMING telemetry and claim authority rather than creating a tenth lane.
programming_rules: PROGRAMMING loads CURRENT-AUTHORITY.programming_work_program_lock, programming_control_record and programming_system_packet before selecting work.

The Programming packet preserves Foundation, capability-ledger, crosscut, closure-repair, programming-core/source-code, CODE-QUAL and Genesis evidence as reusable continuity inputs; do not restart them merely because peer admission is new.
Programming-specific software-engineering semantics remain PROGRAMMING work even when shared Core execution/model/storage/A-01 primitives are consumed.
WEBSITE_BUILDING is capability C40 within PROGRAMMING; it does not own browser side-effect policy, credentials, domains/DNS, publication or production provider authority.
Knowledge Recovery supports Programming source/custody/provenance under CORE and does not replace Programming engineering.
freshness_rules: The morning manifest is a cache and reconciliation receipt, not authority over later repository movement.
Every chat start re-fetches current authority and every relevant live active-owner control head.
A head, job-lock, completion-status or state change after manifest generation is AUTHORITY_DELTA and is reconciled before work.
anti_surprise_rules: Do not ask the user to restate System Master, repository identity, active topology, prior work, archived research, Second Shift history, system job assignments or completion truth when canonical lookup can resolve it.
Do not recreate or reactivate PROSE.
Do not restart completed Programming foundation/capability/assurance work; load the Programming continuity lock and packet first.
Do not create Website Building as an independent system or route its browser side effects through Programming.
If durable authority cannot resolve a decision, ask only the smallest exact human/private/native/external decision required.
authority_boundary: This manifest accelerates startup and records reconciliation. It does not transfer PASS, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, native, external, publication or production authority.
